description: Capture a PNG screenshot of a public web page via the system Chrome, or on OpenScreenShot Cloud with cloud: true. Use redact to cover elements, text patterns, or rectangles with black boxes before the screenshot is taken, in either mode. The capture fails with no image if a selector matches nothing or the page changes during the capture.

cloud.description: Render on OpenScreenShot Cloud instead of the local Chrome. Needs an API key from `openscreenshot auth login` or OPENSCREENSHOT_API_KEY.

patterns.description: Text patterns to find and cover in page text and form values.

rects.description: Rectangles to cover, in pixels of the output image.

selectors.description: CSS selectors to cover. Each must match at least one element, or the capture fails.

name: capture_screenshot
